registeredQuestions.minimumWitness: Does each frozen external candidate have a globally minimum two-coordinate protocol witness under the declared reconciliation rule?
registeredQuestions.strictInteraction: Does the pair reproduce the target while neither singleton changes the base conclusion?

interpretation.supported: All five frozen candidates retained a globally minimum witness of cardinality two under the declared MPW sufficiency rule.
interpretation.notSupported: The study did not establish a pure two-way interaction under the stricter preregistered criterion, because no candidate had both singleton substitutions leave the base conclusion unchanged.
interpretation.claimBoundary: Minimum-cardinality reconciliation and strict interaction are different claims; this result supports the former and rejects the latter for this frozen candidate set.

limitations: This checked a small frozen candidate set rather than a representative population of evaluation disputes.
The derived result depends on the external grid, endpoint choices, conclusion rule, and exposed coordinate mapping declared by the study runner.
The GitHub Actions artifact contains the full derived outputs; this compact ledger preserves the result and provenance but is not a substitute for rerunning the workflow.
A minimum protocol witness is descriptive sufficiency within the exposed grid, not a causal attribution.
